content.caption: Stacked bar charts of Answer Agent F1, B1, and J scores before RL, after PPO, and after GRPO for Llama3.1-8B-Instruct and GPT-4o-mini memory managers.
content.description: Two side-by-side bar chart panels share a y-axis labeled 'Score in %' running from about 20 to 80. Panel (a) is Llama3.1-8B-Instruct and panel (b) is GPT-4o-mini. Each panel has three bars for the metrics F1, B1 and J. Each bar is layered: blue for Before RL, red for PPO and green for GRPO. The top edge of each colored segment marks that method's score. The estimated values below are read at those segment tops. In both panels, PPO improves on Before RL and GRPO scores highest on every metric. Gains are larger with GPT-4o-mini, and J scores are highest overall, reaching about 72 for GRPO with GPT-4o-mini.
